summary_en: 500,000 shares (3.03% of shares outstanding), up to ¥1.50B, open-market purchase on TSE Prime, Aug 3–Dec 30, 2026. Reason: shareholder return enhancement and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, the board of Tomoku Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime: 3946) resolved to acquire up to 500,000 of its own ordinary shares, representing 3.03% of shares outstanding (computed: 500,000 ÷ 16,496,278 ex-treasury shares), for a maximum total amount of ¥1.50 billion. Acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 3 August 2026 and 30 December 2026. The company stated that the acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while enabling flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions. No price ceiling per share is disclosed.
